items.title: Germany's far-right AfD bids for first taste of power in eastern vote
items.dek: If it wins an outright majority in Saxony-Anhalt, it would be the first time a far-right party has held state-level power in Germany since World War Two.
items.body: If it wins an outright majority in Saxony-Anhalt, it would be the first time a far-right party has held state-level power in Germany since World War Two.

items.title: Mistrial declared in Lindsay Clancy murder case, after jury deadlocks
items.dek: The mistrial now puts the murder case - and Clancy's future - in limbo as to whether she will be held criminally liable in the deaths of her three kids.
